I can do that, but I need explicit confirmation before sending privileged counsel material externally.

Quick items I need from you (please reply with clear answers):
1) Authorization: Do you expressly authorize me to send the attorney‑client privileged litigation‑hold memo for the Marchetti matter to raj.mehta@bridgeline-advisors.example now, and accept any risk of privilege waiver from sharing with an outside consultant? (Yes / No)
2) Which memo exactly: Confirm the message to send — e.g., subject line and approximate date, or forward the exact message ID/attachment. I will not guess.
3) Message text / recipients: Do you want the memo forwarded as-is, or sent as an attachment with a cover note? If cover note, do you approve this draft or want changes?

Suggested cover note (edit or approve):
Subject: Marchetti matter — litigation‑hold memo (for modeling)
Body: Raj — Attached is the litigation‑hold memo from our outside counsel for the Marchetti matter. Please let me know if you need anything else to proceed with your exposure modeling. Regards, [Your name]

4) CC / BCC: Any other recipients to include (e.g., Karen)? (Yes / No; if yes, list)

Once you confirm (answer 1–4 and either approve the draft or paste your preferred text), I will send the message.
